items.en: MCP tools are streamlined: adding items always takes a list, and failed calls include a hint on what to do next.
items.zh: 精简 MCP 工具：添加条目统一接受列表，调用失败时附带下一步提示。

items.en: Sem's tool definitions are leaner, so each request uses less context.
items.zh: 精简 Sem 的工具定义，每次请求占用的上下文更少。

items.en: Token counts now show in k and M, and the context usage bar no longer shows stray lines.
items.zh: token 数统一以 k、M 显示，上下文用量条不再出现多余的分隔线。

items.en: Sem picks the right tools more reliably and recovers from failed actions with clearer guidance.
items.zh: Sem 选择工具更准确，操作失败时能按提示更快纠正。

items.en: API reference pages in the docs load faster.
items.zh: 文档中的接口参考页面加载更快。
